capabilities: Edit LaTeX with a live MathJax-rendered preview above the source pane
Insert symbols from a 13-group, 370-item palette rendered as real formulas
Insert formulas from 66 grouped templates and save personal favorites with JSON import/export
Write inline or display formulas into the note in a single undoable editor operation
Export formulas as LaTeX, MathML, SVG, or 3x PNG with white or transparent background
extras: Interface is bilingual (Simplified Chinese / English, auto-follows app language); upgrading from older versions requires renaming the plugin folder to math-box; no default hotkey — users must bind one in Settings.
problem: Obsidian only renders LaTeX; composing formulas still requires typing raw LaTeX from memory with no visual picker, preview pane, or image export.

relations.evidence: rendered through the host MathJax (renderMath), 200 ms debounce

summary: Visual LaTeX formula editor with live MathJax preview, a 370-item symbol palette, formula templates, favorites, and LaTeX/MathML/SVG/PNG export.
